desc: Derive and document the reverse-placement invariant: value i goes into the P_i-th still-empty slot when processing i from N down to 1.
Implement the full solution: Fenwick tree over 1..N (padded to power of two) with k-th free-slot selection via binary lifting, process i=N..1, output space-separated array.
Verified correctness on both public samples (Sample 1 → "4 2 3 1"; Sample 2 → "1 2 3 4 5").
Cross-check against brute-force O(N^2) list-insertion on random small cases including P_i=1 and P_i=i; no mismatch.
Benchmark the solution at N=5×10^5; applied the exec-unrolled k-th-one search; samples still pass.
Final boundary validation (N=1, n a power of two, all P_i=1, all P_i=i) and single-line space-separated output confirmed.
